Name: Slime Extended - English (ENG)
Author: FryoKnight
Description:
This is an English translation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26457]Slime Extend[/url] by [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Skeleton0w0/about-me?gameId=1303]Skeleton0w0[/url]﻿

Adds the following:
[spoiler]Added new sapling: Slime Saplings!
[list]
[*]When planted, they grow into slime trees, similar to wild trees such as oak, maple, and maple.
[*]Slime trees will not drop any wood or sap when chopped down. Instead, it drops 60-100 slimes.
[*]Slime trees will still grow in winter, and moss will never grow on slime trees.
[*]If a sap collector is placed on a slime tree, 12-24 slimes will be produced every two days.
[/list]
Added new artisan item: Slime Mayonnaise
[list]
[*]There are five types of slime mayonnaise: Green, blue, red, purple, and tiger.
[*]Slime mayonnaise sells for three times as much as slime eggs of the same color.
[*]Slime Mayonnaise is considered poisonous, and will drain your Energy!
[/list]
Added the following processing recipes to the mayonnaise machine:
[list]
[*]Adding a slime egg: Produces a slime mayonnaise of the corresponding color.
[/list]
The following processing recipes have been added to the Slime Egg Press:
[list]
[*]Add petrified slime: 2-4 slime saplings will be produced.
[*]Add Slime Fish: 1 Green Slime Egg will be produced.
[*]Put any slime egg that is not "tiger" in color: 1-2 slime eggs with a higher price will be produced (green → blue → red → purple → tiger).
[/list]
Added new recipes for slime:
[list]
[*]Slime Honey Mousse: The recipe can be purchased with honey at the Adventurer's Guild.
[*]Slime Pudding: Recipe unlocked when combat skill level reaches 6.
[*]Tiger Omelet: The recipe can be purchased from the island merchant on Ginger Island using Tiger Slime Mayonnaise.[/spoiler]
[/list]
